purpose: Test exhaustive dynamic invoke/skip policies at the paper's delimiter-token sentence-granularity boundaries, while excluding delimiters that are plainly internal to numbers or unfinished arithmetic.
paper_boundary_definition: A delimiter-token set D (e.g. commas and periods); the trigger acts only when the current token belongs to D. The released code uses comma, period, and newline.
inference_boundary_rule: released-code delimiters comma/period/newline, excluding numeric commas, numeric periods, blank lines, unclosed GSM8K calculator spans, and punctuation immediately following an unfinished arithmetic operator
depth_3_interpretation: checkpoint-native maximum of three inference invocations
depth_5_interpretation: diagnostic oracle with the same weights and inference limit temporarily raised from three to five
